tei:div.tei:p: ༈ na maḥgu ra we/ rgyal kun gsung rab snying po mkha' 'gro yi/ /zhal lung 'jigs bral chos skyong bzhed pa'i gzhung / /gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /thugs dam snying po gsung ngag glegs bam mchog /rin chen gser las bzhengs pa'i byed po ni/ /sde dge khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa ste/ /'dis mtshon rnam dkar dge tshogs kun gyi mthus/ /tshe 'dir bsam kun chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /skye kun bstan pa spyi dang chos tshul 'di'i/ /'dzin skyong spel ba'i byed por legs byung ste/ /mngon mtho nges legs mchog gi lam bgrod nas/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /'brel yod bsngo dgos yid la gang yod rnams/ /mi dbang byams pa'i stobs sogs rtogs brjod bzhin/ /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i sgo phye nas/ /bde ba chen po'i pho brang cher 'jug shog /ces pa a wadhu ti kun spangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa buddha lakṣ+mīs smras so/ /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rgyal kun gsung rab snying po mkha' 'gro yi/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
